title: PS5 Pro Adds Extra Shine to Your Assassin's Creed: Black Flag Remake
summary:
PS5 Pro supported detailed by Ubisoft.

Now less than two weeks away from launch, Ubisoft has uploaded the exact specs you can expect from every graphical mode present in Assassin's Creed: Black Flag Resynced on PS5.

To cut to the chase, you can go from 30FPS to 60FPS — and potentially in between — while maintaining a 4K resolution and some level of ray tracing. Three modes (Performance, Fidelity, and Balanced) accommodate this on both the base PS5 and the PS5 Pro, but you'll want the latter for the best experience.
